name: Materialize Trusted Dataset
purpose: Turn bounded source material into a deterministic, validated, lineage-bearing dataset version with recoverable execution evidence.
outputs: trusted dataset version or quarantine residue
invariants: exactly one logical accepted-history authority exists per run
RWO carries control events and data references, never bulk dataset bytes
a source checkpoint is accepted only after durable publication
validation failure cannot reach dataset publication
resume derives the next structural command from accepted history
